plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Stops risky commands (deletes, hard resets, force pushes) and shows what they would hit before a person presses Proceed; hard-blocks writes to Chris's pen-rule folders.

plugins.name: brain-dump
plugins.description: Catches long, messy voice brain dumps before Claude reads them and offers to tidy them into a clear prompt (task, why, guardrails, done looks like, open questions). Off until /braindump on; tidying uses one small AI call.

plugins.name: browser-peek
plugins.description: The terminal-browser mod: /peek URL takes a headless Chrome screenshot of a page (a site Claude built, a pull request) and shows it in a panel beside the chat, so you review without leaving Claude Code. Fresh Chrome profile, no logins. Uses no AI.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Shows how long until this chat's prompt cache goes cold, warns before a cold message re-reads the whole chat at full price, and /keepwarm pings it cheaply while you step away (up to 2 hours).

plugins.name: chat-inventory
plugins.description: An 'In this chat' panel like Cowork's: the goal, connectors called and how often, skills used, links fetched, and a file tree that shows which files Claude read, is editing, or changed. Uses no AI.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Gives every subagent a name, its own color and a character (fox, owl, octopus...), and shows live what each one is doing and how far along it is, above the prompt and in a /crew panel. Uses no AI.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Type /handoff (or press the button it offers when a chat passes 250k tokens or its cache goes cold) to get a detailed prompt that moves the work to a fresh chat with nothing lost; saved under ~/Developer/claude-mods/handoffs.

plugins.name: heads-up
plugins.description: The 'you should know' mod: after a long reply, a small model reads it and pops up anything you must not miss (costs, irreversible steps, deadlines, things waiting on your yes, risks). Uses a little AI on long replies only; /headsup off to stop.

plugins.name: helper-desk
plugins.description: A progress bar above the prompt that fills as to-dos are ticked off, and a panel showing each subagent, what it is doing, and its token cost. Uses no AI.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: Spots when you give Claude a lasting rule (never, always, from now on, stop doing, I don't want) and offers to save it to a rules inbox you promote into CLAUDE.md or a skill. Uses no AI.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: After Claude edits files, type /replay (or press Replay above the prompt) to step through every change one by one as a before/after diff. Uses no AI and changes nothing.

plugins.name: screen-share
plugins.description: Type /screenshare before sharing your screen: names, emails, phone numbers, money amounts and keys in the chat turn into gray bars, and tool details are hidden.

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Reskins how Claude Code shows its work: each tool call gets an icon and color, and the spinner gets themed words. /skin labeau | noir | tokyo | off. Display only, uses no AI.

plugins.name: switchboard
plugins.description: Type /mods to see every mod in this session, switch Chris's mods on or off mid-chat, and block any other plugin from loading next time.
